tier_reason: Tier C stands; caveats corrected to say the memtier run replays one key sequence across all clients (0.00 hits, about 909 keys), so it measures per-request round-trip cost of a 4-command toy server with two Neco I/O threads against single-threaded Redis.

corrections.caveats: First-party single memtier run (Ryzen 9 5950X): all 200 clients replay the same key sequence (constant generator seed, 0.00 hits, about 909 keys), so the 2.4x is per-request round-trip cost, not key-value throughput; Bluebox ran with two Neco I/O threads against redis-server's default single io-thread, clients may differ (PATH vs local memtier_benchmark), 4-command toy server.
